claim: Base UI ships zero CSS and prescribes no styling solution; you style via className (string or function of state), style prop, data attributes and exposed CSS variables.
quote: Base UI components are unstyled, don't bundle CSS, and are compatible with Tailwind, CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS, or any other styling solution you prefer.

claim: Base UI v1.0.0 shipped 11 December 2025 with 35 unstyled components and a renamed npm package @base-ui/react; latest is v1.6.0 (17-18 June 2026).
quote: Stable 🎉 35 unstyled UI components. New `@base-ui/react` npm package. New website. Fixed focus and transition issues across multiple components.

claim: InfoQ (Feb 2026) reports Base UI 1 as production-ready after two years, 35 accessible components, maintained by MUI with Radix and Floating UI core developers contributing — not a formal company merger.
quote: Base UI components come completely unstyled, allowing teams to implement their own design systems without fighting against default CSS.

claim: Base UI is built by people from Radix (Colm Tuite), Floating UI (James Nelson) and Material UI (Michał Dudak, Marija Najdova and others).
quote: Base UI components are unstyled, don't bundle CSS, and don't prescribe a styling solution.

claim: Select exposes state via data attributes (data-popup-open, data-open, data-closed, data-side, data-align, data-highlighted, data-selected, data-disabled, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-placeholder) and positioning via CSS variables --anchor-width, --anchor-height, --available-height, --available-width, --transform-origin; docs examples use CSS Modules.
quote: Positioner provides: --anchor-height, --anchor-width, --available-height, --available-width, --transform-origin

claim: Base UI Combobox is composed of 26 separately styleable parts (Root, Input, InputGroup, Chips, Chip, ChipRemove, List, Portal, Backdrop, Positioner, Popup, Arrow, Status, Empty, Collection, Row, Item, ItemIndicator, Group, GroupLabel, Separator, ...); the component list contains no Table or DataGrid.
quote: Accordion, Alert Dialog, Autocomplete, Avatar, Button, Checkbox, Checkbox Group, Collapsible, Combobox, Context Menu, Dialog, Drawer, Field, Fieldset, Form, Input, Menu, Menubar, Meter, Navigation Menu, Number Field, OTP Field, Popover, Preview Card, Progress, Radio, Scroll Area, Select, Separator, Slider, Switch, Tabs, Toast, Toggle, Toggle Group, Toolbar, Tooltip

claim: Install is a single tree-shakable package (@base-ui/react, v1.6.0); no Tailwind plugin is required, styling is entirely left to the consumer.
quote: since Base UI is unstyled, you can use CSS-in-JS, plain CSS, or any other styling solution you prefer

claim: Tailwind 4 styles Base UI state natively: bare boolean data variants (data-active:border-purple-500) for flag attributes like data-open/data-disabled, and data-[side=top]: bracket syntax for valued attributes — no plugin needed.
quote: To check if a data attribute exists (and not a specific value), you can just specify the attribute name: <div data-active class="border border-gray-300 data-active:border-purple-500">

claim: As of July 2026 Base UI is the DEFAULT primitive layer in shadcn/ui; Radix is not deprecated and both ship for every component; opt back in with `shadcn init -b radix`.
quote: Starting today, Base UI is the default component library in shadcn/ui. ... Radix is not being deprecated. We still support it, and every update and new component will ship for both libraries. ... Base UI is stable. It's at 1.6.0 with 6M+ weekly downloads. ... Projects created on shadcn/create now pick Base UI over Radix 2 to 1.

claim: shadcn/ui added Base UI as a selectable primitive in December 2025 (via `npx shadcn create`) with visual parity between the Radix and Base UI builds — the Tailwind class layer is shared.
quote: When we launched `npx shadcn create` in December, we introduced the ability to choose between Radix and Base UI as your component library. ... The components look and behave the same way. Only the underlying implementation changes.

claim: 2026 comparison: Radix, Base UI, React Aria, Ark UI and Headless UI all ship unstyled primitives; Radix updates slowed after the WorkOS acquisition and Base UI is now considered the more actively maintained primitive layer.
quote: Radix UI was acquired by WorkOS and updates have slowed for some components. ... Base UI (maintained by MUI) is now the more actively maintained primitive layer.

claim: Styling cost of Base UI stated bluntly: you write all the CSS for every component, there are no themes, no color schemes, no pre-built design patterns, and it requires design skill.
quote: You write ALL the CSS - Every button, every dialog, every tooltip ... Requires design skills - You need to know what good UI looks like ... ❌ Any CSS whatsoever / ❌ Color schemes or themes / ❌ Pre-built design patterns

claim: HN thread on shadcn defaulting to Base UI (5 Jul 2026, 282 points, 165 comments): positive on the primitives, but the loudest criticism is aimed at the copy-paste/vendoring model rather than Base UI itself.
quote: That's great. Started using Base UI early on via 9ui and found the primitives very pleasant to work with — dabinat / The copy paste approach is just a plain bad idea, I am not sure why this doesn't get more criticism — dbbk

claim: MUI states Base UI is stable, is where its foundational work is concentrated, and that MUI Base is deprecated and replaced by Base UI; focus for 2026 is expanding the component set and migration guidance.
quote: We recently reached a major milestone by releasing Base UI as stable ... Base UI is where we are concentrating our foundational work going forward. ... MUI Base has been deprecated and replaced by Base UI, which represents our long-term direction for foundational, unstyled components.

claim: Third-party pre-styled Tailwind layers on Base UI exist: Shadcnblocks added Base UI support 5 Feb 2026, switchable via one line in components.json with identical Tailwind styling across both primitives.
quote: you can now choose between Radix UI and Base UI as the underlying primitive library for your shadcn/ui components — and switch between them with a single line in `components.json`

claim: basecn.dev is a shadcn-style pre-styled Tailwind component collection built specifically on Base UI, with its own Radix-to-Base-UI migration guide.
quote: Migrating from Radix UI

claim: radix-ui/primitives is still active (last push 2026-07-13) at 19,064 stars / 339 open issues, but is no longer shadcn's default primitive.
quote: radix-ui/primitives stars=19064 open_issues=339 pushed=2026-07-13T10:36:53Z archived=false

claim: v1.6.0 (18 June 2026) was bugfix-only — no new components — with a breaking rename OTPFieldPreview -> OTPField; even post-1.0 minors can carry breaking export renames.
quote: The OTP Field namespace export was renamed from OTPFieldPreview to OTPField

claim: Radix-to-Base-UI migration is component-by-component, not a drop-in: asChild is replaced by an explicit render prop and positioning moves to @floating-ui/react; a big-bang replacement is advised against.
quote: One of the most notable improvements in Base UI is the move from Radix's asChild pattern to a more explicit render prop approach
